title: Raaste Mein Kele Ka Chhilka! 🍌 | Yeh Bhi Sadqa Hai | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Raaste mein kele ka chhilka! 🍌 Zara ne dekha, Ali ne utha kar dustbin mein daala — aur Dadu ne bataya ki yeh bhi sadqa hai. Saaf-safai aur doosron ka khayal — bachchon ke liye ek pyaari Islamic kahani.

Hadith: "...wa tumeetul-adha 'anit-tareeqi sadaqah"
Matlab: Raaste se takleef dene wali cheez hata dena bhi sadqa hai.
English: Removing something harmful from the road is charity.

📖 Source:
• Sahih Bukhari 2989, Sahih Muslim 1009 — Abu Hurairah (RA) (Sahih)

Aap ke bachche ne aaj kaunsa achha kaam kiya? Comment mein batayein! 👇
Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah: Ali aur Dadu.
